x: The FileTypesManager is a static object containing a registry of file type loader functions.Each file type (such as `image`, `audio`, `tilemapTiledJSON`, etc.) registers itself herevia the `register` method. When a LoaderPlugin is instantiated, it calls `install` to copyall registered file type methods onto itself, making them available as `this.load.image()`,`this.load.audio()`, and so on within a Scene.

m.x: Static method called when a LoaderPlugin is created.Loops through the local types object and injects all of them asproperties into the LoaderPlugin instance.

p.x: The LoaderPlugin to install the types into.

m.x: Static method called directly by the File Types.The key is a reference to the function used to load the files via the Loader, i.e. `image`.

p.x: The key that will be used as the method name in the LoaderPlugin.
The function that will be called when LoaderPlugin.key is invoked.
